address: 19 Yen Bai Street, Hai Chau 1 Ward, Hai Chau District, Da Nang, 550000, Vietnam
bio: You can smell the barbecue from a distance. Bún thịt nướng, or rice noodles with barbecue pork, is the must-try. Or go for barbecue with salad and rice paper – choose from pork, minced pork skewers, pork belly, and beef....
